mapper.select: SELECT id, album_id AS albumId, filename, filepath, uploaded_at AS uploadedAt, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM image WHERE album_id = #{albumId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, filename ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image (id, album_id, filename, filepath, uploaded_at, sort_order) VALUES (#{id}, #{albumId}, #{filename}, #{filepath}, NOW(), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order),0)+1 FROM image AS t WHERE album_id = #{albumId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE image SET sort_order = #{order} WHERE album_id = #{albumId} AND filename = #{filename}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM image WHERE album_id = #{albumId} AND filename = #{filename}
